# Standard Agent Handoff Report Template

### Standard Agent Handoff Report

- **Task**: [Unique Task Identifier and Descriptive Name]
- **Agent**: [Current Specialist Agent Name, e.g. Solution Architect]
- **Status**: [Complete | Blocked | In Review | Needs Escalation]
- **Inputs**: [Clickable links or exact file paths of inputs consumed, e.g. [PRD.md](file:///home/akhil/Vibe%20Coding/Flatmate/docs/requirements/PRD.md)]
- **Deliverables**: [Clickable links to produced artifacts, e.g. [api-spec.yaml](file:///home/akhil/Vibe%20Coding/Flatmate/docs/architecture/api-spec.yaml)]
- **Decisions**: [Key architectural, design, or business logic decisions made and rationale]
- **Dependencies**: [Pre-requisite tasks completed or downstream tasks enabled]
- **Open Questions**: [Unresolved questions, assumptions, or ambiguities identified]
- **Handoff Recipient**: [Next agent responsible, e.g. Chief Orchestrator, Frontend Engineer]
- **Review Requirements**: [Level 1: Independent | Level 2: Review Required (name reviewers) | Level 3: Human Approval Required]
